summary: The visible suite now passes (3 passed). I changed two files under `solution/`. The main cause was in `solution/util.py`: the tokenizer regex listed the single-character class `[+\-*/%()]` before `\*\*`, so every `**` was split into two `*` tokens and the parser never saw a power operator. I reordered the alternation so `\*\*` is matched first. In `solution/core.py`, `power()` parsed its exponent with `atom()`, which contradicted its own comment that the right-hand side allows unary minus; it now calls `unary()`, so `2**-1` evaluates to `0.5`. I spot-checked `2**3**2` (512), `-2**2` (-4), `2*3**2` (18), and a few other expressions, and nothing under `tests/` was touched. I did not run the hidden suite, so the remaining risk is behavior the visible tests don't cover.
